question_en:
The community shared kitchen plans to purchase the used spice containers shown in the photo. After cleaning, they will be used to store herbs or spices with a sodium content of less than 10 mg per teaspoon. Sodium content is based on the corresponding unsalted generic food entries in the USDA FoodData Central; mixed seasonings whose ingredients cannot be confirmed will not be purchased for now. Please answer the following questions:

1. What spice containers appear individually in the photo, and what are their respective contents? Which USDA FoodData Central unsalted generic entry corresponds to each type of contents? What is the sodium content per teaspoon? Please list the contents, the adopted entries, and the calculation results in a table.

The answer must use a complete item-by-item table listing 'Container and Contents — Adopted USDA FoodData Central Entry — Sodium Content per Teaspoon'.
